versions.changelog:
Initial release: Build and refresh solopreneur brand identities with clear processes and guidance.

- Covers brand purpose, values, personality, voice & tone, visual identity system (colors, typography, logo), tagline, and brand guidelines.
- Step-by-step structure: foundational strategy first, then voice, visuals, and documentation.
- Includes practical frameworks and examples for defining voice, personality, and tone adjustments for different communication contexts.
- Provides actionable rules for color palette, typography selection, basic logo direction, and imagery style.
- Delivers an outline for an all-in-one brand guidelines document to ensure consistency.
